text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Biwa Hayahide and I were having a meeting
to formulate our strategy for the upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Based on these figures, we can deduce that this race will feature
a slightly aggressive early pace. Now, let us review the entered runners once more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As mentioned earlier, runner number four will be key.
Observe her data over the past three races. Consequently—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her theories were sophisticated as ever, and I could barely keep up.
As I frantically took notes to stay on track...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over there.
Hayahide-san is talking about some crazy complicated stuff.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right. As expected of the top genius in our grade.
She really is incredible... On a totally different level.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what you even have to do to get that smart.
Just study like crazy or something?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
People like her are just built different from birth!
There's no way we could ever pull that off~.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...'Incredible,' is it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No... it is nothing.
Now then, let us continue our meeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, throughout the rest of our discussion,
Biwa Hayahide occasionally drifted into pensive silence—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —and even after leaving the cafeteria, a subtle gloom lingered over her expression.
choice_data_list: ...Are you bothered by what our classmates said?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. No... You're right, my apologies.
It really is nothing of consequence.
choice_data_list: If you're willing, I'd like to hear what's on your mind.
If you're willing, I'd like to hear what's on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Being described as 'incredible' feels discordant to me.
That word inherently implies something extraordinary, does it not?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, to an outside observer, approaching everything through rigorous logic
might appear to be an arduous, complex feat. But...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Being utterly ordinary, arming myself with theory was the only path available to me.
Otherwise, I wouldn't have even managed to enroll in this academy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thus, originally, the word "amazing" ought to be reserved
for those horsegirls blessed with innate, natural genius.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was likely picturing her younger sister—
the "Monster," Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having such a legendary sister may have left her harboring complex feelings
that outsiders could never truly grasp. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has honed a weapon unique to herself through sheer, relentless effort.
I told her there was no doubt in my mind that she was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I will polish this weapon even further and navigate
these fierce battles by your side. That resolve remains unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet, Trainer… it is also my honest feeling
that I simply wished to be superior, as an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To yearn for raw potential—something that no amount of effort
can ever alter—even I find myself utterly appalled by such folly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Biwa Hayahide gazed into the distance, a faint trace of insecurity was visible in her eyes.
Even as calm and composed as she always is, she has her vulnerable side.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, pay me no mind; that was foolish talk. Moving on… it isn't on the schedule,
but I'd like to get in some training based on our earlier meeting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Formulas require swift verification. If we delay,
it will only take longer to correct any underlying errors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Biwa Hayahide hurry ahead as if driven by something unseen,
I was left pondering how I could help her find true confidence in herself.
